places.coord_source: Nominatim (OSM) building-level match for '618 Bernard Avenue, Kelowna, BC'
places.note_en: Kelowna's main free settlement agency for permanent residents and refugees (BC NSP also serves work-permit holders, international students and new citizens); call 250-763-8008 ext. 1.
places.note_zh: 基隆拿主要的免费移民安置机构，服务永久居民和难民（BC NSP 项目也服务工签持有人、国际学生和新入籍公民）；致电 250-763-8008 转 1。
places.verify_notes: KCR contact page lists Immigrant Services at '618 & 654 Bernard Ave.' (two buildings), phone (250)763-8008 ext. 1; I used 618 as the primary address (654 Bernard Ave geocodes to 49.8864482,-119.4891341). Settlement page lists eligibility (PRs, protected persons, IRCC-selected PRs, CUAET holders; visitors not eligible) but does not explicitly say 'free' — 'free' is based on IRCC/BC NSP programme rules, not stated on the KCR page. Hours not shown on kcr.ca (third-party directories say Mon–Fri 8:30–12, 1–4:30; unverified). No other IRCC-funded settlement provider with a Kelowna office could be confirmed from an official page (S.U.C.C.E.S.S. Kelowna office not found; Okanagan College appears in IRCC grant data but no settlement-service page confirmed).

places.coord_source: Nominatim (OSM) named match 'Service BC, 305-478 Bernard Avenue'
places.note_en: Provincial services in person — BC Services Card/MSP, income assistance and other BC government help; open Mon–Fri 9:00–4:30.
places.note_zh: 省政府服务窗口——办理 BC 服务卡/MSP 医保、收入援助等省政府业务；周一至周五 9:00–16:30。
places.verify_notes: Address, phone and hours confirmed on gov.bc.ca. The URL gov.bc.ca/servicebc/kelowna redirects to www2.gov.bc.ca//servicebc/kelowna (double slash); the single-slash form above should be checked in a browser.

places.n: Kelowna Service Canada Centre and Passport Services
places.note_en: Federal services in person — Social Insurance Number (SIN), passports, EI, CPP/OAS; bring your immigration documents; open Mon–Fri 8:30–4:00.
places.note_zh: 联邦政府服务窗口——办理社会保险号（SIN）、护照、就业保险、CPP/OAS 养老金；请携带移民身份文件；周一至周五 8:30–16:00。
places.verify_notes: Address (471 Queensway, Suite 106) and hours confirmed on the office page. The office page lists NO local phone number; 800-622-6232 is the national 1 800 O-Canada general line (canada.ca/en/contact/contact-1-800-o-canada.html), not a Kelowna line. The office page's TLS certificate failed WebFetch validation; text was read via curl.

places.coord_source: Nominatim (OSM) named match 'ICBC - Kelowna Driver Licensing, 1720 Springfield Road' (ICBC's own locator gives 49.876876,-119.460556)
places.note_en: Exchange your foreign driver's licence, take knowledge/road tests and get a BC ID; book an appointment online and bring your licence and immigration documents.
places.note_zh: 换领外国驾照、参加笔试/路考、办理 BC 身份证；请在网上预约，并携带原驾照和移民身份文件。
places.verify_notes: Address and phone taken from the data embedded in ICBC's official locator page (businessName 'Kelowna Driver Licensing'). 800-950-1498 is ICBC's province-wide driver licensing line, not a local number. Locator hours: Mon/Tue/Thu/Fri 8:30–4:30, Wed 9:00–4:30. ICBC has no per-office page; 'w' is the locator. Area: Springfield Rd near Spall (Midtown/Landmark) — classed dt.

places.n: ICBC West Kelowna Driver Licensing (by appointment only)
places.coord_source: Nominatim (OSM) match 'West Kelowna City Hall, 3731 Old Okanagan Highway' (ICBC locator gives 49.82775,-119.62387)
places.note_en: Driver licensing on the 2nd floor of West Kelowna City Hall — licence renewals, knowledge tests and Class 4/5/7 road tests, by appointment only.
places.note_zh: 位于西基隆拿市政厅二楼的驾照办理处——驾照更新、笔试及 4/5/7 级路考，仅限预约。
places.verify_notes: Address confirmed by the ICBC newsroom release (2nd floor of City Hall, 3731 Old Okanagan Highway) and the ICBC locator data ('201-3731 Old Okanagan Highway'). Phone is ICBC's province-wide line from the locator. The locator sets displayServiceHours=false, so no public hours.

places.coord_source: Nominatim (OSM) address-point match for '1835 Gordon Drive, Kelowna, BC'
places.note_en: Free job-search help, employment counselling and training funding for job seekers; open Mon–Thu 8–6, Fri 9–4.
places.note_zh: 免费求职帮助、就业辅导和培训资助；周一至周四 8:00–18:00，周五 9:00–16:00。
places.verify_notes: Address, phone and hours confirmed on workbc.ca. Postal code shows V1Y 3H4 on workbc.ca vs V1Y 3A4 in search snippets of the operator's site (not used here). workbc.ca notes that hours may change during wildfire events.

places.coord_source: Nominatim (OSM): the query with 'West Kelowna' returned nothing; '3011 Louie Drive, Westbank' matched a business node at 3011 Louie Drive (same building, different unit)
places.note_en: Free job-search help and employment services for West Kelowna residents; open Mon–Thu 8–6, Fri 9–4.
places.note_zh: 为西基隆拿居民提供免费求职和就业服务；周一至周四 8:00–18:00，周五 9:00–16:00。
places.verify_notes: Address, phone and hours confirmed on workbc.ca. The coordinate is from another business node at the same civic address, not the WorkBC unit itself.

places.n: Legal Aid BC – Kelowna (Kelowna Law Courts)
places.coord_source: Nominatim (OSM) address match for '1355 Water Street, Kelowna, BC' (Kelowna Law Courts)
places.note_en: Apply for free legal aid (family, criminal, some immigration matters) if you have a low income; open Mon–Thu 9–12 & 1–4, Fri 9–12.
places.note_zh: 低收入人士可在此申请免费法律援助（家庭法、刑事及部分移民案件）；周一至周四 9:00–12:00、13:00–16:00，周五 9:00–12:00。
places.verify_notes: Legal Aid BC lists the Kelowna location as 'Michael Newcombe, Barrister & Solicitor' (a contracted local agent) at Kelowna Law Courts, 228–1355 Water St, phones 250-763-8613 or 250-763-3594. There is no Kelowna-specific page; 'w' is the locations list. Legal Aid BC's province-wide call centre number was not collected.

places.coord_source: Nominatim (OSM) address-point match for '554 Leon Avenue, Kelowna, BC'
places.note_en: Free legal advice and representation on tenancy, income/disability assistance, EI, employment, family law and other issues that legal aid doesn't cover.
places.note_zh: 免费法律咨询和代理，涉及租房、收入/残疾援助、就业保险、劳动、家庭法等法律援助不覆盖的问题。
places.verify_notes: Address and 236-425-9120 confirmed on the contact page and site header. The homepage footer ALSO shows 236-425-9121 — the phone number needs a human check. Hours and income eligibility are not stated on the site. A news report says the clinic is operated by the (Kamloops and District) Elizabeth Fry Society and lists 250-374-2119 / legalclinic@kamloopsefry.com; that is not confirmed on an official page. No law-student legal clinic serving Kelowna was found (UBC's LSLAP serves the Lower Mainland only; SUO student legal aid is for UBCO students only).

places.coord_source: Nominatim (OSM) named match 'Central Okanagan Food Bank, 2310 Enterprise Way'
places.note_en: Free food by appointment; register online first and bring photo ID for each adult, ID for each child and proof of a Kelowna/West Kelowna address.
places.note_zh: 免费领取食物，需预约；请先在网上登记，并携带每位成人的带照片证件、每个孩子的身份证明以及基隆拿/西基隆拿的住址证明。
places.verify_notes: Office hours are Mon–Fri 8:30–3:30 per the contact page (search snippets said 8:00–4:00; contact page used). Area: Enterprise Way is in Midtown (Hwy 97 corridor near Orchard Park), between dt and gm; classed dt. A West Kelowna branch exists at 203-3710 Hoskins Rd, phone 250-768-1559 (Mon–Fri 9–3), not added as a record because Nominatim matched only the road, not the civic number.

localCrisis.note_en: Non-police mobile mental-health crisis team for people aged 13+ in Kelowna; voluntary and consent-based.
localCrisis.verify_notes: Confirmed on CMHA Kelowna's page. The City of Kelowna's CRCL page (kelowna.ca/city-services/safety-emergency-services/crisis-response-community-led-crcl) returned HTTP 403 to automated fetches and could not be cross-checked.
